issues.description: The Vietnamese is correct, but 'chuyển ra khỏi ngôi nhà cũ' sounds a little formal/literal for a short spoken line. 'dọn ra khỏi nhà cũ' sounds more natural for moving out.
issues.suggested_fix: Mình vừa mới dọn ra khỏi nhà cũ.

issues.description: The rent gloss is understandable, but 'tiền thuê nhà trả hàng tháng' is a little compressed. A cleaner gloss would use 'hằng tháng' and make it clear this is a gloss.
The grammar note is simple, but adding the Vietnamese equivalents for 'just' and 'already' would help an A2 Vietnamese learner connect the forms to meaning.
issues.suggested_fix: Use 'just' (vừa mới) to say something happened a very short time ago. Use 'already' (đã … rồi) to say something happened before now, often sooner than expected.

qa_report.summary: This is a clear, short A2 micro-dialogue. The story is easy to follow, the target word 'rent' appears naturally, and the review words 'room' and 'house' are included. The Vietnamese translations are mostly good; I only suggest small naturalness tweaks and adding Vietnamese cues in the grammar note.
